answer: The wheel either ripens true or it cracks and weeps, and the maker saves a kernel of the last good batch to start the next. Proof of cheese press via cheese makers guild is a press of that kind: a press the cheese makers guild stamps only after the maker turns a wheel he actually pressed. A beacon marks the dairy door, and the curd is cut or it clouds. 27 invented presses take 27 makers and 27 wheels the maker never pressed; each wheel is washed in brine until it shines like a pearl, and not one of them ever ripened.
